name: Peter Sloterdijk as “First Philosopher” of Globalization
headline: Peter Sloterdijk as “First Philosopher” of Globalization
description: The article offers information on philosopher Peter Sloterdijk that includes absence in translations of Sloterdijk's philosophical teachings; consideration of Sloterdijk's teaching as pop-cultural; and assessment of phenomenology towards globalization conditions.
